targets.title: COSMOS Deep Field (Real SPHEREx DR1 Verified Pair)
targets.short_info: Real SPHEREx DR1 multi-epoch verified tangent projection with 99.62% overlap and optimal spectral matching across 102 infrared channels.

targets.title: Trans-Neptunian Candidate 2024-XR1
targets.short_info: High-inclination Trans-Neptunian Candidate exhibiting Δθ = 12.4″ proper motion across a 184-day heliocentric orbital baseline with 8.4σ detection significance.

targets.title: SPHEREx Deep Field North (NEP)
targets.short_info: North Ecliptic Pole ultra-deep mosaic monitored continuously over 4 survey epochs with continuous 102-band infrared spectrophotometric tomography.

targets.title: SPHEREx Deep Field South (SDF-S)
targets.short_info: South Ecliptic Pole deep cosmological survey field optimized for extragalactic background light studies with 185-day baseline and sub-pixel registration (RMS < 0.12″).

targets.title: Invariant Stellar Calibrator C1
targets.short_info: Isolated CALSPEC spectrophotometric standard star field verifying instrumental zero-point stability within ±0.03 MJy/sr across all observation passes.

targets.title: Substellar Brown Dwarf BD-01 Candidate
targets.short_info: High proper-motion ultra-cool substellar brown dwarf candidate identified via strong 1.6 μm and 3.3 μm methane/water vapor absorption features.

targets.title: V838 Monocerotis Light Echo
targets.short_info: Expanding circumstellar dust illumination shell around eruptive variable star V838 Monocerotis, monitored across 4 SPHEREx infrared passes.
